instruction:
Open `/home/user/Desktop/board.brd`, create a new user layer numbered `101` named `Fab_Notes`, place at least one wire and one text annotation on that layer in the board's `<plain>` section, and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/annotated.brd`.

Requirements:
1. `/home/user/Desktop/annotated.brd` must parse as well-formed XML.
2. `<layer number="101" name="Fab_Notes".../>` must exist under `<layers>`.
3. The board's `<plain>` block must contain at least one `<wire layer="101"/>`.
4. The board's `<plain>` block must contain at least one `<text layer="101"/>`.
5. Every starter layer number must remain present.
6. The element count must remain unchanged.
